summary:
Public Law 118-124, the "Fiscal Year 2024 Veterans Affairs Major Medical Facility Authorization Act" (enacted from H.R. 6324, approved November 25, 2024), authorizes the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to undertake a discrete set of enumerated major medical facility projects for fiscal year 2024 and authorizes appropriations to fund them.

Section 1 provides the short title. Section 2(a) confers project-specific authority: it permits the Secretary to carry out eleven identified major medical facility projects in FY2024, each at a specified location and subject to a per-project statutory ceiling ("in an amount . . . not to exceed"). The authorized projects, with their respective caps, are: American Lake, Washington ($155,600,000); Dallas, Texas ($93,100,000); El Paso, Texas ($759,200,000); Perry Point, Maryland ($274,310,000); Portland, Oregon ($613,000,000); Reno, Nevada (Sierra Nevada Health Care System replacement initiation, including land acquisition and preliminary site work — $223,800,000); San Diego, California ($311,700,000); San Francisco, California ($264,500,000); San Juan, Puerto Rico ($370,370,000); St. Louis, Missouri (Phase 1 — $135,340,000); and West Haven, Connecticut ($153,128,000). The scopes of work are project-specific and include new construction, renovation, seismic retrofit/corrections, parking expansion, utility plant work, land acquisition, and demolition, as detailed for each site.

This authorization operates within the statutory framework governing VA major medical facility projects under 38 U.S.C. Chapter 81 (notably 38 U.S.C. § 8104, which requires specific statutory authorization of major medical facility projects before funds may be obligated). The bill does not amend, repeal, or add new sections to the U.S. Code; it functions as freestanding project authorization legislation of the type contemplated by section 8104.

Section 2(b) is an authorization of appropriations, distinct from an appropriation. It authorizes to be appropriated to the Secretary $3,354,048,000 for the projects authorized in subsection (a), available for FY2024 "or the year in which funds are appropriated for the Construction, Major Projects account." This aggregate figure corresponds to the sum of the per-project ceilings. No budget authority is provided by this Act; actual funding requires a separate appropriation.

The Act contains no sunset provision, no separate effective-date provision (thus taking effect upon enactment), and no stated deadlines or conditions precedent beyond the per-project cost ceilings and the FY2024/year-of-appropriation availability limitation applicable to the authorized appropriations.
